title: What Everybody Wants

frozenSources.support: Use sympathy for the other person's ideas and desires as a way to lower defensiveness without surrendering judgment.

conceptFocus: sympathy for ideas and desires is not agreement
people want to feel their ideas and desires are understood
precision matters more than vague validation
guardrails: preserve the line between sympathy and agreement
keep sympathy tied to reduced defensiveness

bridges.previousChapter: Chapter 17 made the other person's motives more legible.
bridges.nextChapter: Chapter 19 will show how appeals to nobler motives can change the story people tell themselves.
